items.title_orig: My grunge record collection as of August 2026
items.article_text:
For the last year, the grunge era has been my main genre to listen to. While I had listened to some of the hits from the bands seen here (Plush, Them Bones, Black Hole Sun, Even Flow), I hadn't listened to their discography in full. That changed when a user on Twitter told people to listen to Stone Temple Pilots in April of last year, and "Core" was my true introduction to the grunge era. I fell in love and continued onto Purple which became my favorite album of all time (as of right now at least lol), then I started digging further into Alice in Chains, Pearl Jam and Nirvana's discography. And since then, I've listened to a lot of albums from the era in full (still not finished) and honestly? I don't see it ever leaving my mind now.
 This era has hit me in an important period of my life.
